name: Social Dropdown
description: Dark dropdown select for social platforms with an animated chevron, staggered list reveal, a sliding hover highlight and a small icon badge that follows the cursor.
contents: Titled label above a select button showing the chosen platform icon and name
Collapsible list of platforms with hover highlight and cursor-following icon badge
behavior: Click the button to expand or collapse the list with a height and opacity transition
Hover highlight slides between rows and an icon badge follows the pointer
Clicking a row selects it and closes the list

props.name: platforms
props.default: Linkedin, Instagram, Facebook, Twitter, Youtube with SVG path data

editableByProps: Platform list names and icon paths, initial selection, title
Panel width, card background, badge color and text color

needsCodeEdit.change: Change row height used by the hover highlight

fixed: Root fills the viewport height and centers its content. Override with className using an important modifier such as !h-auto.
Loads the Plus Jakarta Sans Google font link while mounted and removes it on unmount
Icons must be 16x16 viewBox SVG path strings
